title: Impact of Institutional Ownership on Firm Value
research_question: Does increased institutional ownership, as influenced by inclusion in the S&P 500 index, negatively affect firm value? The study aims to identify the causal impact of changes in ownership structure on firm valuation, using index inclusion as an instrumental variable.
data_description: The dataset includes 300 firms with columns for firm value (y), institutional ownership (x), S&P 500 inclusion status (z), and other control variables (controls). The sample tracks firms over time, capturing changes in ownership and valuation metrics.

ground_truth.identification_strategy: Use S&P 500 inclusion as an instrument for institutional ownership.
ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Increased institutional ownership, driven by index inclusion, leads to a decrease in firm value.
